bio.text: Glenn Ivey was elected in 2022 and represents Maryland's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House.
He graduated from Princeton University in 1983 and Harvard Law School in 1986, and was an Assistant U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia from 1990 to 1994.
Ivey chaired Maryland's Public Service Commission after an appointment in 1998, and was elected State's Attorney for Prince George's County in 2002, serving two consecutive terms.
